exec_summary.headline: Prompt-to-product tools now build apps and models
exec_summary.body: Google Play's personal Android app workflow and OpenStudio's plain-language building models show creation moving from chat into usable software and simulation.

exec_summary.headline: AI is moving into the science workflow
exec_summary.body: This week's strongest research examples span whole-building energy modeling, chemistry campaigns, crystal structures and quantum-circuit design.

exec_summary.headline: Frontier models are arriving with concrete research results
exec_summary.body: Gemini 4 Argon pairs new physics results with a free science tier, while open models and skills make experimentation easier to reproduce.

exec_summary.headline: Solo builders are finding measurable agent wins
exec_summary.body: The week's builder stories include small teams replacing paid software and packaging repeatable agent workflows into tools others can try.

exec_summary.headline: Creator platforms are adding control and new ways to earn
exec_summary.body: Feed controls, creator monetization and social-commerce features give individuals more ways to shape, publish and grow their work.
